💷 The government borrowed £1.8bn in July. The OBR had forecast a £500m surplus.

Income tax receipts hit a record £17.1bn — and it still wasn't enough to balance the books.

Borrowing is down 9.6% across the year so far, but still above forecast. Debt is now £2.985 trillion.
